title: Firework Pack
body: ## The **ULTIMATE** Optimization Modpack # Overview **What it optimizes?** It optimizes CLIENT and SERVER side things like Rendering, Block Entities, Memory Allocation, Chunk Loading, and Network Packets. --- **Why Choose Firework?** * Maximum Performance: Specially engineered to squeeze every single frame out of your hardware. Get a stable 340+ FPS at 10 Chunks even on entry-level and mid-range setups, such as an i5 CPU and 8GB DDR4 RAM. * Smart Rendering: Optimizes how Minecraft handles block entities, particles, and complex geometry without sacrificing the game's original visual fidelity. * Server & Client Harmony: Reduces micro-stutters and local server tick lag (internal server), ensuring smoother movement, faster world loading, and a highly responsive competitive gameplay experience. * Lightweight & Clean: No bloatware or unnecessary features. Just pure, raw performance improvements from the ground up.
